summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_151 findings, run with Playwright measurements (Alice + Bob, preview, nothing paid, upgraded, bought or deleted). (1) PageHeader buttons PASS. At 768, 820, 1024 and 1180: numbers-buy-button, sip-page-open-phone, ai-agents-new-button and campaigns-new-button are each 42px tall, and wallet-refresh-button, inbox-mark-read-button and help-whats-new-button are each 36px. All sit on one line, right-aligned, while the long subtitles wrap. At 390 they all sit under the h1 with no horizontal scroll. EXCEPTION: buy-search-button on /app/buy is still 51px (label on two lines) at 768, 820 and 1024. It is not in a PageHeader: it sits in the 4-column search form in BuyNumber.js, where the column is about 152px wide. It is 42px at 390 and 1180. (2) Help layout PASS. At 768, 1024 and 1180 the help-contact-card and help-shortcuts-card sit side by side below the articles. At 1280 and 1440 they are in the right column. help-open-assistant-button and help-support-link are 42px (one line) at every width. (3) Billing upgrade pay row PASS (Bob +19103709316, Business, See price). The wallet button, coin select and crypto button are all exactly 44px and fully inside billing-upgrade-card at 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1180, 1440, 1920 and 2560, with no horizontal scroll. (4) Wallet at 1024 PASS. The date cells are whitespace-nowrap and the tables scroll inside their overflow-x-auto wrappers (table 349px inside a 302px wrapper), with no page horizontal scroll. (5) Regression PASS. overflow_audit.js ran on /app, /app/numbers, /app/numbers/%2B17377031678?tab=billing, /app/wallet, /app/help and /app/settings at 360, 1024 and 1920. Result: 0 horizontal scroll, 0 spills, 0 off-screen elements, 0 tall buttons, 0 squashed icons. New minor finding: at 1024 the Wallet balance figure ($360.00, text-5xl mono) breaks onto two lines ('$360.0' / '0') in the narrow balance card.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Search numbers' button breaks onto two lines (51px tall) at 768-1024. Cause: the form uses md:grid-cols-4, so each column is about 152px. Fix: use md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 (or xl:grid-cols-4), or add whitespace-nowrap to the button and let the grid size it.

issues: The wallet-balance figure (font-mono text-5xl) breaks in the middle of the number ('$360.0' / '0') because wallet-balance-card is only about 224px wide at 1024. Larger balances will be worse. Use text-4xl xl:text-5xl plus whitespace-nowrap, or a clamp() font size.

action_items: BuyNumber.js: stop the 'Search numbers' button breaking onto two lines at 768-1024 (change the grid breakpoints or add nowrap)
Wallet.js: make the wallet-balance figure smaller at lg widths, or nowrap, so '$360.00' does not break at 1024
critical_code_review_comments: ui.js PageHeader: the left block <div> still has no min-w-0 (the review note said it was added). It works now because the subtitle has max-w-2xl, but add min-w-0 so long unbroken titles cannot push the actions out.
Help.js aside reports computed position 'sticky' even below xl (it was seen at 768). This is harmless in the stacked layout, but check that no other class sets sticky.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all 5 retest items pass; 1 leftover button on Buy at 768-1024 plus 1 new minor wallet balance wrap)
